tier: Rotating Residential Proxy Premium Plan (per GB)

free_tier.stated: No self-service free tier. 'Do you offer trials? Yes, you can contact our online support to test our residential proxies.'
free_tier.notes: A trial exists only through the vendor's support chat; its size is not stated on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a traffic pack or an address, not an object

retention.stated: Premium Plan traffic 'has no expiration date before allocation', unlike the basic plan. Static residential IPs are leased for a period (up to 90 days on the home page) and 'You simply need to extend the validity period before the IP expires' to keep the same address.
retention.notes: The short-term residential product is 'Pay per IP. Unused IP credits never expire.'

egress.terms: Rotating residential and mobile products are billed per GB; static residential 'is billed by time period with no traffic limits'; the unlimited residential product is priced per hour with 'No traffic limits'.
egress.free_allowance: none stated; a trial on request through support

interface_detail: HTTP and SOCKS5 forward proxy with username-password or IP-allowlist authentication; an API, a client app with port forwarding and a web dashboard are documented. Sticky sessions run 5 to 180 minutes on the rotating product.
tooling: Any client that speaks an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy with credentials or an allowlisted source address, or the vendor's client app. Documentation is hosted at docs.lokiproxy.com.
chaining: The vendor's gateway is an HTTP or SOCKS5 forward proxy, so it is dialled from a host that can open outbound proxy connections (a rented or free virtual machine); the upstream then sees an address from the vendor's pool instead of the host's own.

limits.value: rotating residential billed per GB from 0.48 USD per GB; high-purity pool from 1.2 USD per GB; mobile from 0.91 USD per GB
sticky IP stays for at least 5 to 180 minutes, then until the server restarts; random IP rotates every request

limits_note: Other price points on the navigation: short-term residential IP from 0.02 USD per IP; unlimited residential from 12 USD per hour; static residential from 0.12 USD per IP per day; IPv6 from 1.9 USD per IP. Pool claims: 35 million residential IPs and a 10 million high-purity pool, 190+ countries.
binding_note: The purchased GB is the quantity that runs out; the 0.48 USD per GB floor belongs to the Premium Plan, whose traffic does not expire before allocation.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers 'Sign up with Google' or 'Create account' and states 'Ready-to-use upon registration, no complex verification.' The terms also list failure to comply with KYC requests among grounds for suspension, so a KYC step may be requested. The account form fields beyond that were not readable. The refund policy says no refunds are issued after order completion or proxy use.

reliability_note: No refunds after order completion or proxy utilisation. The vendor publishes 99.9% success rate and under 0.5 s response, unverified here. The footer logo image on the vendor's pages carries the alt text IPPeak, the name of another proxy vendor with its own record (ip-proxy/ippeak-dual-ntt); whether the two are one operator is not established.
confidence_note: Prices, plan names, trial and registration lines are quoted from the vendor's pages read on 2026-11-03. No address was sampled, so the registration class of the delivered addresses is unverified; the identity-form fields beyond Google or email sign-up were not readable.
